results.question: What is the coordinates location of the circuits for Australian grand prix?
results.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng 
FROM circuits AS T1 
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitId = T1.circuitId 
WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

results.question: List down Ajax's superpowers.
results.final_sql:
SELECT T3.power_name 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id 
INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.power_id 
WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Ajax'

results.question: List the top five schools, by descending order, from the highest to the lowest, the most number of Enrollment (Ages 5-17). Please give their NCES school identification number.
results.final_sql:
SELECT T2.NCESSchool, T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` 
FROM frpm AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC 
LIMIT 5

results.question: What is the average number of crimes committed in 1995 in regions where the number exceeds 4000 and the region has accounts that are opened starting from the year 1997?
results.final_sql:
SELECT AVG(T1.A15) 
FROM district AS T1 
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
WHERE T1.A15 > 4000 
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) >= '1997'

results.question: How many male clients in 'Hl.m. Praha' district?
results.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) 
FROM client AS T1 
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'

results.question: What is the average fastest lap time in seconds for Lewis Hamilton in all the Formula_1 races?
results.final_sql:
SELECT AVG(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(T2.fastestLapTime, ' ', ''), ':', '.') AS REAL)) 
FROM drivers AS T1 
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId 
WHERE T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T2.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL

results.question: From race no. 50 to 100, how many finishers have been disqualified?
results.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T2.driverId) 
FROM races AS T1 
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId 
WHERE T1.round BETWEEN 50 AND 100 AND T2.statusId = 1

results.question: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019') -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020') AS difference

results.question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
results.final_sql:
SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / T1.enroll12 ASC 
LIMIT 1

results.question: Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules which contain the Chlorine element.
results.final_sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' AND T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END)
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'

results.question: How many users received commentator badges in 2014?
results.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Commentator' AND STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2014'

results.question: Among the patients with a normal Ig G level, how many of them have symptoms?
results.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG BETWEEN 800 AND 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

results.question: How many superheroes have the super power of "Super Strength"?
results.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.hero_id) FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Super Strength'

results.question: Please list the name of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
results.final_sql:
SELECT T2.name 
FROM cards AS T2 
INNER JOIN sets AS T1 ON T1.code = T2.setCode 
WHERE T1.name = 'Coldsnap' 
ORDER BY T2.convertedManaCost DESC 
LIMIT 1

results.question: For all patients with normal uric acid (UA), what is the average UA index based on their latest laboratory examination result?
results.final_sql:
SELECT AVG(T2.UA) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.UA <= 6.5 
  AND T2.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(T3.Date) 
    FROM Laboratory AS T3 
    WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
  )

results.question: User No.23853 gave a comment to a post at 9:08:18 on 2013/7/12, was that post well-finished?
results.final_sql:
SELECT T1.PostId, T1.Score, T1.Text, T2.FavoriteCount, T2.AnswerCount, T2.CommentCount
FROM comments AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id
WHERE T1.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0' AND T1.UserId = 23853

results.question: How many members of Business have the Medium size of tee shirt?
results.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id

results.question: What is the type of the card "Ancestor's Chosen" as originally printed?
results.final_sql: SELECT originalType FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

results.question: Which active district has the highest average score in Reading?
results.final_sql:
SELECT T2.District, T1.AvgScrRead 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active' 
  AND T1.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC 
LIMIT 1

results.question: Please provide the IDs of the 3 female clients with the largest loans.
results.final_sql:
SELECT T1.client_id
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
INNER JOIN loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY T4.amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

results.question: Among all the lap records set on various circuits, what is the time for the fastest one?
results.final_sql: SELECT time FROM lapTimes ORDER BY milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: In superheroes with missing weight data, calculate the difference between the number of superheroes with blue eyes and no eye color.
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) - 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.colour IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS difference
FROM superhero AS T1 
LEFT JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg IS NULL

results.question: In the College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences, how many majors are under the department of School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education?
results.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(major_name) FROM major WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences' AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

results.question: Mention the display name and location of the user who owned the excerpt post with hypothesis-testing tag.
results.final_sql:
SELECT T2.DisplayName, T2.Location 
FROM tags AS T1 
INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T1.ExcerptPostId = T3.Id 
INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T3.OwnerUserId = T2.Id 
WHERE T1.TagName = 'hypothesis-testing'

results.question: List all patients who were followed up at the outpatient clinic who underwent a laboratory test in October 1991 and had a total blood bilirubin level within the normal range.
results.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.* 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Admission = 'outpatient' 
  AND T2.Date LIKE '1991-10-%' 
  AND T2.`T-BIL` BETWEEN 0.2 AND 1.2

results.question: Among the molecules with element Calcium, are they mostly carcinogenic or non carcinogenic?
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'carcinogenic'
    ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
  END AS majority_label
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

results.question: Please list the full names of the students in the Student_Club that come from the Art and Design Department.
results.final_sql:
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id 
WHERE T2.department = 'Art and Design'

results.question: List all the mythic rarity print cards banned in gladiator format.
results.final_sql:
SELECT T1.name 
FROM cards AS T1 
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
WHERE T1.rarity = 'mythic' 
  AND T2.format = 'gladiator' 
  AND T2.status = 'Banned';

results.question: Among posts by Harvey Motulsky and Noah Snyder, which one has higher popularity?
results.final_sql:
SELECT T2.Id, T2.Title, T2.ViewCount 
FROM users AS T1 
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId 
WHERE T1.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder') 
ORDER BY T2.ViewCount DESC 
LIMIT 1

results.question: Mention the reputation of users who had obtained the badge on 7/19/2010 7:39:08 PM.
results.final_sql: SELECT T1.Reputation FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Date = '2010-07-19 19:39:08.0'
